# Loom 2.2 — T3 Code Support, Multi-Agent Telemetry & Notification Polish
Version **2.2.0**, build **7**.
## Highlights
- **T3 Code Integration**: Native detection, orchestration hierarchy mapping, and real-time lifecycle tracking for T3 Code sessions alongside child CLI agent processes. - **Multi-Agent CLI Telemetry**: Robust session detection and token usage metrics across Codex CLI, Claude Code, and Antigravity CLI with live process tree scanning. - **Phantom Process Filtering**: Eliminated phantom `Home (~)` sessions and bare idle background daemons/helpers (`codex app-server`, `ChatGPT.app` crashpad handlers) when no real user coding session is active. - **Provider Reordering**: Drag-and-drop reordering of providers in Settings with persisted preferences and dynamic Menu Bar sections. - **Developer App Launchers**: One-click quick launch for registered AI coding agent environments and workspaces. - **GitHub Star Community Prompt & Notification**: Native macOS notification with structured 3-line hierarchy, zero-truncation subtitle (`github.com/chaiwithcode/Loom`), SF Symbol hover actions (`★ Star on GitHub` and `Maybe Later`), and deduplicated Menu Bar invitation card.
## Monitoring & Discovery
- **Strict CWD & Transcript Correlation**: Background CLI processes running with `cwd == "/"` or `cwd == ~` are only linked to transcripts modified within the last 5 minutes, preventing stale background helpers from inflating session counts. - **Process Hierarchy & Descendant Traversal**: Automatic attribution of child worker subprocesses to their parent agent sessions. - **Bare Unknown Process Suppression**: Processes without workspace metadata, worker subprocesses, or valid transcripts are cleanly filtered from active session lists and diagnostics.
## Compatibility & Distribution
- Requires macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) or later on Apple Silicon (arm64). - Production artifacts are signed with Developer ID, notarized by Apple Notary Service, and verified with `stapler`. - Automated Sparkle 2 appcast and Homebrew Cask release updates.

# Loom 2.1 — T3 Code, Multi-Agent Telemetry & Provider Customization
Version **2.1.0**, build **6**.
## T3 Code Integration
- Native discovery and tracking for **T3 Code** threads and sessions. - Direct SQLite thread monitoring with non-blocking WAL-safe read-only locks (`SQLITE_OPEN_READONLY | SQLITE_OPEN_NOMUTEX | SQLITE_OPEN_URI`). - Real-time token consumption reporting (input, output, and context token breakdown). - Native application launcher button to directly open or focus T3 Code from the Menu Bar and Storage settings. - Storage directory telemetry for T3 Code workspaces and projects.
## Multi-Agent CLI Telemetry
- Intelligent process tree scanning and bounded JSONL transcript parsing for **Codex**, **Claude Code**, and **Antigravity** CLI agents. - Automatic correlation of child CLI processes launched or orchestrated by parent environments. - Accurate active, idle, waiting for approval, and completed state detection with token usage calculation. - Workspace root path sanitization and automatic cleanup of terminated sessions.
## Provider Reordering & Customization
- Custom provider ordering in Settings → Providers that dynamically propagates across every Loom surface: - Menu Bar provider filter pills (with compact 2-row layout and single selection). - Sessions view (ordering both the provider pills and combined session list). - Usage & Quota meters. - Storage telemetry. - WidgetKit extension widgets.
## Interface & Quota Polish
- **Native App Launchers**: One-click "Open App" launchers in Menu Bar popovers and Storage settings for installed providers. - **Graceful Quota Notices**: Resilient quota handling for Antigravity and T3 Code, avoiding false-positive error warnings when local servers or apps are idle. - **Native GitHub Star Card**: A beautifully crafted Liquid Glass card in Settings → General with dismissible state and direct project link. - **Optimized Menu Bar**: Compact "All" provider pill, clean two-row provider bar, and waiting badges for icon-only mode.
## Release Verification & Compatibility
- **macOS Requirement**: macOS 14.0 or later (Apple Silicon native). - **Code Signing & Security**: Signed with Apple Developer ID Application (`K9UNF256S9`), Hardened Runtime enabled, notarized and stapled by Apple Notary Service. - **Update Verification**: Distributed via GitHub Releases (signed DMG & ZIP), Sparkle 2 (Ed25519 signature), and Homebrew Cask (`chaiwithcode/tap/chaiwithcode-loom`).

# Loom 2.0 — Liquid Glass & Smarter Monitoring
Version **2.0.0**, build **5**.
## Interface
- Native Liquid Glass menu and Settings surfaces on macOS 26, with system-material fallbacks and accessibility adaptations on older supported macOS versions. - Clearer session states, subordinate provider filters, search and attention/working/recent filters. - Needs Attention remains first; Working/Starting and Idle precede Unknown sessions. Ordering is deterministic within each group. - Multiple bare Unknown processes without a logical session or workspace collapse into an expandable unidentified-process group. Known sessions stay separate; details and actions remain accessible. - Consistent Settings layout, fixed reset action, aligned controls and an About section with real project links.
## Monitoring and notifications
- Separate local lifecycle observation and slower quota polling, dynamic menu-bar status and expanded discovery diagnostics. Observed quota alerts support Codex and Antigravity; Claude Code does not expose quota through its upstream local interface. - Production quota notification state uses persistent storage, preserving threshold deduplication across restarts. A reset alert requires fresh ordered observations crossing the previous known reset boundary and substantial quota restoration into a later window. - Finished alerts have a minimum observed Working duration: Always, 2 minutes, **5 minutes by default**, or 10 minutes. This counts time observed while Loom monitors; it does not infer work from process age. Waiting and failure alerts remain immediate. - Unknown transitions, provider failures and disabled providers are not treated as confirmed completion evidence for notification purposes. Further disappearance/correlation reliability work is tracked in the roadmap. - Notifications default to enabled for new/missing preferences and Restore Defaults, preserving stored opt-outs and macOS permission choices. Normal launch requests permission only when undecided and enabled. - Test-notification controls and sending code are compiled only into Debug builds. - Bounded local notification history, privacy-aware content, Finder/copy/focus actions and observed quota consumption rate.
## Widgets
- App icon plus Sessions, Quotas or Overview headings; gallery names and widget configurations remain compatible. - Full-width stacked Large quota rows, semantic warning colors matching the menu, and neutral cached data. - Aggregate quota layouts omit providers with unsupported quota reporting; explicit provider selection retains its explanation. Claude remains represented in session counts. - Medium Overview combines session activity and tightest known quotas, while Quotas retains per-window detail. Large views allocate a bounded six-row quota budget and retain honest overflow links.
## Compatibility and release verification
- macOS 14 or later. This release targets Apple Silicon. - Existing preferences, explicit notification opt-outs, widget kinds and provider selections are retained. Missing completion-duration preferences default to five minutes. - Release verification results are recorded in the [2.0 checklist](RELEASE_CHECKLIST_v2.0.0.md). - Download links open the latest published release.
